finding: Runtime persistence failure could abandon running jobs while reporting the composer ready.
resolution: Retain an unavailable recovery state until project-scoped interrupted outcomes are durable; reconcile after 1 second with exponential delay capped at 30 seconds. Never replay model work. Stop timers on shutdown and refuse a replacement database. Check the recovery state inside submit so requests that awaited their body cannot return stale replay receipts.

regressions.command: bun test src/brief/composition.test.ts src/daemon/api-brief-composition.test.ts --test-name-pattern "runtime storage recovery"
covers: Timeout and provider failure while job writes are rejected
Unavailable capability and HTTP 503, including a replay whose body finishes during the outage
Repeated reconciliation failure then recovery without daemon restart
Original prompt, job and journal identity, cancelled receipts and idempotent replay preserved
No automatic model replay or late draft; a new explicit request ID works after recovery
Shutdown cancels recovery; old timers cannot touch a reopened database

verification.hooks: Normal commit hooks required; final outcome recorded in the canonical project state.
